lead_headline: Restaurant tracker flags 9 weekend leads including Kokopelli container bar (Westminster) and Miya Moon reopening (Baker) as foreclosures stay quiet below $4M and subscriptions edge up +1

restaurant.blurb: 9 leads flagged since Friday: Kokopelli Social Bar (Westminster container bar), Tavern on Blake Street (Five Points sports bar reopening), Miya Moon (Baker Chinese), BARna Soccer (Colfax tapas), Ichigo Matcha (University), Blazing Bird East (Colfax). Closures: River Bar, Yardbird RiNo.

liquor.blurb: Eighth straight zero-application day pushes statewide dormancy into fourth week—7-day window frozen at 369 licenses, all filed June 14 during single-day backlog purge. June's 26-day count stuck at 369 versus typical 800+ monthly baseline. No new submissions, status changes, or removals since mid-month clearance event. Unprecedented void now exceeds all prior records as system silence suggests permanent operational shift rather than seasonal lull or technical glitch.

reputation.blurb: Weekend drought continues—0 mentions yesterday holds 7-day total at 55 mentions across 15 sources, up 12% from prior period despite Saturday-Sunday freeze. Denver Post delivered 19 weekend citations (35% share), covering Kennedy Golf Course planning, water connection fees, Clean Eatz expansion. Facebook contributed 8, Instagram 5, Reddit 4. Week's volatility mirrors June pattern—strong Monday-Thursday, Friday-Sunday collapse—as monthly count (191) tracks toward 250-citation finish. Google News RSS captured 54 of 55 discoveries.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 since Friday (1 new, 0 canceled) breaks weekend dormancy, lifting MTD to +25 (+1.2/day) while 90-day net holds at +131. Week's +9 performance (17 new, 8 canceled) outpaces prior period's +4 as lower churn (8 vs 18 cancellations) offsets weaker acquisition. Recent fortnight shows clustering—Jun 11-18 delivered +16 before collapse—but weekend's single addition keeps MTD velocity (+1.2) aligned with YTD baseline (+1.2/day) as June's final third begins.
